sources.locator: docs overview: service + client SDKs; supported backends and SDK matrix
sources.observed: PowerSync: service replicates backend Postgres/Mongo/MySQL/SQL Server, partitions per user/device via sync rules, streams to client SQLite via SDKs (JS/RN/Node/Flutter/Kotlin/Swift/.NET/Rust); local-first reads/writes, queued sync.

PostgreSQL docs define EXCLUDE USING gist constraints; with btree_gist + range overlap operator they prevent overlapping rows at DB level; canonical booking pattern uses (resource_id WITH =, tstzrange WITH &&).

sources.locator: search results: exclusion-constraint booking pattern with partial predicate + btree_gist
sources.observed: Independent booking codebases use CREATE EXTENSION btree_gist + EXCLUDE USING gist (resource WITH =, tstzrange WITH &&) WHERE (active statuses); app maps 23P01 exclusion_violation to user message; final backstop under races.

sources.locator: search results: PouchDB local IndexedDB/WebSQL + CouchDB replication live/retry
sources.observed: PouchDB runs in browser on IndexedDB/WebSQL, same API offline/online, syncs with CouchDB-compatible servers when online (live/retry); offline changes queue locally; conflicts are multi-revision requiring app merge; JS/MapReduce overhead on large data.

sources.locator: docs index: Django/Python support matrix; history storage + querying/revert/as_of
sources.observed: django-simple-history stores Django model state on every create/update/delete; supports Django 5.2/6.0/6.1 + Python 3.10-3.14; history querying incl. as_of/most_recent/revert; full snapshots; misses non-ORM writes.

sources.locator: homepage: data software/standards; packaging/transform/push; validation workflow
sources.observed: Frictionless Data: open-source toolkit/standards for packaging data with schema, validating (upload→preflight→decision→import/review), transforming, pushing to stores; addresses uneven rows, missing fields, inconsistent values, formula markers.
